# bronto_user (Resource)

Manages a Bronto user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bronto_user" "example" {
  first_name = "Jane"
  last_name  = "Doe"
  email      = "jane.doe@example.com"
  roles      = ["Standard"]

  # Optional: disable individual login methods for this user. Any method
  # not listed here uses the organization-wide default.
  login_methods = [
    {
      name    = "Password"
      enabled = false
    },
  ]
}

# Deactivate a user without deleting them, keeping their history and access
# grants intact. Setting `active` back to true reactivates them.
resource "bronto_user" "on_leave" {
  first_name = "Sam"
  last_name  = "Taylor"
  email      = "sam.taylor@example.com"
  roles      = ["ReadOnly"]
  active     = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The user's email address
- `first_name` (String) The user's first name
- `last_name` (String) The user's last name
- `roles` (List of String) A list of role ids

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user account is active. Set to false to deactivate the user, or true to reactivate a previously deactivated user. Deactivating a user that has never been activated (e.g. status INVITED) has no effect.
- `login_methods` (Attributes Set) Per-user overrides for enabling or disabling specific login methods (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--login_methods))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the user
- `invited_at` (Number) Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last invitation sent to the user
- `invited_by` (String) Identifier for the user who sent the latest invitation
- `last_logins` (Map of Number) A map of login methods to their last login timestamps (Unix epoch).
- `status` (String) Current status of the user
- `tags` (Map of String) A map of key value pairs associated with the resource

<a id="nestedatt--login_methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `login_methods`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Flag to enable or disable a login method override for this specific user.
- `name` (String) The name of the login method

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Users can be imported by their unique ID.
terraform import bronto_user.example 41521f35-1b06-41f0-9cdc-9a938b5739d1
```
